transport: Explicitly awaited per-record Mongo cursor, about 1 MiB UTF-8 chunks, subprocess stdout temporary file, Python file-size guard, json.load validator input.
per_collection_record_bound: Selected byte budget in bytes; no fixed one-million-record ceiling. Byte limit is authoritative.

coverage: Invalid and out-of-range budgets rejected before reads/writes
Actual JavaScript UTF-8 framing and total-byte cap against an asynchronous cursor double
Mock collection count above one million accepted under 2 GiB budget
Truncated JSON, invalid UTF-8 and subprocess errors rejected with temporary descriptor cleanup
Sparse mocked oversized 2 GiB encoder chunk rejected before write; incomplete owned files removed
Existing files preserved; compact JSON byte output and source verification retained

scope: No actual 2 GiB movement file generated. The existing verified native replay and its historical 512-MiB proof were neither re-exported nor modified. Smoke used only fresh owned UUID databases and removed them. Generated motion remains outside Git.
limitations: The byte cap limits serialized file size, not Python or browser memory.
Python validators still construct the complete parsed JSON object. No 2 GiB playback or constant-memory validation guarantee is claimed.

final_review_followup.change: Serialize only four database/collection pairs in mongosh --eval; unrelated route/person/geometry size cannot exhaust OS argument budget.
final_review_followup.regression: A scene containing more than 1 MiB of unrelated private movement configuration produces the same bounded Mongo script as a small scene.
